headline: Steady execution, fairly valued
chart_note: 52-week range: $225.95 - $344.57. Currently $316.22, roughly in the upper-middle of its 52-week range.
why_today: Fiscal Q3 revenue hit a June-quarter record of $109.4B, up 16% YoY, with iPhone revenue up 22% on iPhone 17 demand and EPS growing 29%. Mac and Services also posted record quarters.
pro_1: Analyst consensus is Buy (24 buy / 6 sell), with broad-based growth across iPhone, Mac, and Services
pro_2: Beta of 1.09 - moves roughly in line with the market, a relatively steady large-cap holding
con_1: Average price target of $323.86 implies only modest upside from current levels - a lot of the good news is already priced in
con_2: At 36x earnings, valuation leaves little room for a growth disappointment
